label: v53.57
changes: Removed the capture-phase crew click interception that was causing Navigator to bounce between the legacy crew chooser and the Opening screen
The legacy crew chooser now keeps its original click handler and is auto-clicked using the already saved crew identity instead of redirecting back to the launcher
The stability layer now loads only after the legacy chooser has actually cleared, preventing its old rescue handler from hijacking crew selection
Started a fresh private offline bundle cache generation so previously decorated looping bundles are not reused
Simplified the service worker to a network-first shell plus cached workshop assets without changing shared task state
No project task state, DONE history, assignments, holds, project scope or morning-pack data was reset
